name: Roman Petrovich Pjatifanov
source: Anton's classmate, a skinny kid of medium height, described by Anton as a wild predatory animal, is one of the central characters of Alice's ruth and Polina's antagonists. The leader of the local gang of hooligans, at the age of 12, already had several police records. The guy's character is not the most pleasant: Roma lives "according to the principles", does not disdain to intimidate and offend the weak, is quite cruel, and does not tolerate any weakness or betrayal.
